name: Micaiah
overview: Micaiah is a male prophet mentioned in the books of 1 Kings and 2 Chronicles. His role as a prophet is his defining characteristic in Scripture, where he delivers messages from God. No tribal affiliation or additional personal notes are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Micaiah means 'Who is like y-h-v-h?' This Hebrew name reflects a rhetorical question emphasizing the uniqueness of the Lord. It is a proper name recorded in 1 Kings 22:8 without indication that it was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Micaiah as the son of Imlah, providing a clear familial link. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Micaiah's significance lies in his prophetic office, where he stands as a true messenger of God during critical moments in Israel's history. His role underscores the importance of hearing God's voice through His chosen prophets. Through Micaiah, the Lord communicates His will and judgment, affirming God's sovereignty and faithfulness to His people.
